title: Invertibility of the composite scalar-extended Hom comparison
statement: Let $Y,Y\prime$ be affine and $X,Y,Y\prime$ quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper, flat, and locally of finite presentation [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism], and $g:Y\prime\to Y$. For right adjoints $a,a\prime$ to the quasi-coherent derived direct images and invertible canonical direct-image base change, let $c:Lg_X^*a(K)\to a\prime(Lg^*K)$ be the canonical mate [def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map]. For perfect $M$ and $K\in D_{QCoh}(Y)$ [def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pc-derived-category], the composite of the scalar-extended global Hom pullback comparison of [lem-sc-flat-affine-global-hom-comparison] with $RHom_{X\prime}(Lg_X^*M,c)$, restricted to $\Gamma(Y\prime)$, is invertible. This is invertibility of the composite, before cancelling its first factor. Module and sheaf localization universes are independent.

proof.text: Apply proper-support perfect direct image to M tensored with the structure sheaf concentrated in degree zero. Properness supplies support; flatness and finite presentation supply the other hypotheses. Thus Rf_*M is perfect.
Scalar-extend the global Hom adjunction for f, apply perfect RHom base change on Y, Hom of beta inverse at M, and the inverse global Hom adjunction for f prime. All four factors are invertible.

The flat-precomposition compatibility equates the transpose of this four-factor map with the transpose of the stated composite. Derived-unit and K-flat equations allow independent localization universes. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence gives equality and hence invertibility.

theorem properFlatGlobalHomComposite_isIso
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (R : Type u) [Ring R], HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y']
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (a' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y' ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g))
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
      (fun E ↦ (schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint X Y f).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjf' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y').lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g))
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd f g) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a')
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
        (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition E.obj))
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (M : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (hM : Scheme.IsPerfect X M.obj)
    : IsIso (mixedAffineGlobalHomBaseChangeMap f g M.obj (a.obj K).obj ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction (pullback.snd f g)).map
        ((schemeGlobalDerivedHom (pullback f g)).map
          (X := (op ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M.obj),
            (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj (a.obj K).obj))
          (Y := (op ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M.obj),
            (a'.obj (((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y').lift
              ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⋙ derivedPullback g)
              (fun E ↦ (derivedPullback_tensor_preserve_QCoh g).1
                E.obj E.property)).obj K)).obj))
          ((𝟙 ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M.obj)).op,
            (dualityEquationBaseChangeMap f g a a' adjf adjf' hβ K).hom)))
